entities.summary: Chen Chi-mai, also known as Comay Chen, is a Taiwanese politician and physician who has served as the mayor of Kaohsiung since 2020. He has served as the spokesperson of the Democratic Progressive Party and the chief executive officer of its Policy Research and Coordinating Committee. A physician from Keelung, Chen started his political career by becoming member of the Legislative Yuan in 1996 and served as legislator for almost eight years before becoming the spokesperson of the Executive Yuan.
